title: Fourth increment of the Goal Gravity loop on draft PR #160: founder return report, host-trigger wake schedule, open-attempt guard, and provenance for the third issuance; linked to DELIB-GOAL-GRAVITY-2026-10-13-001 and -2026-10-14-002
problem: Observation: on 2026-10-14 the founder issued the Goal Gravity directive a third time, in a new session, with five supplementary essays, a founder-voiced 'at full intended maturity' statement containing an acceptance scene (a multi-day absence followed by one report of receipts, prepared work, policy blocks, waiting decisions, money and learning), the 2026-09-05 external audit and three AI-generated PDFs. Observation: draft PR #160 already implements targets A-I (three increments, 767 tests, CI green, mergeable, NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION for adoption). Observation: #160 has per-goal status() and global measures() but no cross-goal, time-windowed, ledger-derived digest, and no view that tells a host scheduler when to call turn(). Observation (reproduced on 6ce6b3f): a grantless wake of a goal with an open attempt re-classified the route to PREPARE, wrote a fresh 'planned' record that hid the 'unknown' attempt from _latest_by_route, dropped the reconciliation blocker, and a later grant dispatched the route a second time under an attempt-suffixed proposal id. Inference: the residual CapabilityDeficit this issuance exposes is the founder's return report, the wake-schedule view, and the open-attempt guard; the supplementary materials are mechanism sources and aspirations needing ledger records, not new architecture. Proposal: build that residual as a fourth increment on #160's branch, preserve the materials verbatim with lineage, record fourteen intents with lifecycle states, and activate nothing.
baseline: Draft PR #160 at 6ce6b3f (main d64a6c9 merged): Goal Gravity loop with targets A-I, Competency Compiler seam, acquisition chain, 767 tests passing, verifier V1-V5 green; no return report, no wake schedule, open-attempt guard only inside the EXECUTE arm.

alternatives.name: Fourth increment on #160's branch (selected)
alternatives.description: Add egregore/absence.py (AbsenceReporter, read-only fold, idempotent REPORT_RECORD), egregore/schedule.py (WakeSchedule, read-only), move the prior-attempt guard before classification in turn(), extend closures, add 16 tests including a three-day restart scenario, preserve the supplementary materials and audit verbatim, record fourteen intents, update docs.
advantages: Continues the one canonical lineage the directive's section 22 requires; no parallel GREG
Every number in the report is a fold of records the loop already writes; no new authority object
The defect fix removes a real duplicate-consequence path and is covered by regression tests
Reversible: additive files plus a small loop edit; revert one commit
disadvantages: Adds about 580 lines of source to an already 14k-line draft the founder has not yet ruled on
The report's status_now fields mix present state with window facts (labelled, but a reader may skim)
The loop edit touches the core per-move path; a hidden dependency on re-classification could exist

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The third issuance and its materials remain unrecorded; the founder's acceptance scene has no mechanism; the open-attempt defect stays latent in #160 and would allow a duplicate external dispatch after a grantless wake.
advantages: No new code on a draft awaiting ruling
Zero risk of touching the loop
disadvantages: Violates the ledger rule that no founder intention is silently lost
Leaves a reproduced duplicate-consequence path in the canonical candidate
Leaves P1 (host-owned trigger discovers due work) without the view any scheduler needs

roles.position: The founder's own acceptance scene is the clearest statement of the intended effect in all of the supplied material; it should become code that can be falsified, and every supplementary intention must receive a lifecycle state rather than being summarized away.
material_concerns: Material 1's Master System Prompt must be preserved yet prohibited as a protocol without erasing its three valid effects
The PDFs are AI advisories; only quoted constitution clauses and the four verbatim Final Plan requests are founder expression

roles.position: Both new modules are read-only folds over existing records and bind to nothing new; the guard belongs before classification because _latest_by_route is the loop's single source of truth for a route's state and any later record overwrites it.
material_concerns: Skipping classify() for a route with a prior attempt means no CLASSIFICATION_RECORD for that turn; status() reads the _decisions map, which keeps the last classification, so waiting_work stays truthful
The report counts treasury/business events all-time while everything else is windowed; labelled, but it is a second clock in one document
evidence_refs: egregore/gravity.py (guard at the top of the per-move loop)

roles.position: The defect is real and the fix is minimal, but it changes the core per-move path of a 14k-line draft under founder review; an independent adversarial review with refuting verifiers must run before the increment is pushed, and the report must be attacked for every way it could overstate.
material_concerns: A reader could mistake 'estimated_cost_usd_executed' for money moved despite the note
The headline's first sentence counts goals 'active' if any status transition fell in the window, including a founder pause
Two reports over the same window on a ledger that changed in between produce two records; is that documented?

roles.position: Stdlib only, no services, full suite 33 seconds, verifier green; the report is O(records) per call and should be rotated behind the same ledger-rotation decision the earlier increments already name before 24/7 use.
material_concerns: The report scans the whole ledger on every call; acceptable now, needs an index or incremental fold at scale
Trigger ids embed ISO timestamps; a host must call with the suggested id to get idempotent replay

roles.position: The report must never let an executor's claim, a prepared move or an estimate pass as more than it is; the tests pin each of those; nothing contacts a real person and the report requests nothing. Everything remains synthetic: no real outcome, no real founder, no real money.
material_concerns: Evidence tier is unchanged: IMPLEMENTED / UNIT-TESTED / INTEGRATION-TESTED on synthetic ledgers; FOUNDER-ACCEPTED requires a real absence and a real read
The audit's organ-side findings are preserved but not acted on; they must not be implied repaired

pass_1.intended_outcome: After an absence the founder reads one truthful, ledger-derived report; a host scheduler can discover due work from durable state; a route with an open attempt can never be hidden or re-dispatched; every supplementary intention has a lifecycle state and verbatim lineage.

advantages.statement: One report replaces per-goal status reads
advantages.amplified_value: Becomes the default founder surface after any absence; compounds as more record types land (a settlement record would appear in the money section without a new document); reverses into a liability only if a reader treats it as authority or settlement, which its text forbids

advantages.statement: The wake schedule is the interface every scheduler needs
advantages.amplified_value: Lets the founder choose cron, APScheduler or Temporal without redesign; reverses if a host treats the view as permission to act (it is a time, not a grant)

advantages.statement: The open-attempt guard closes a duplicate-consequence path
advantages.amplified_value: Strengthens the structural authority boundary the earlier increments claimed; reverses only if some path legitimately needs re-classification of an attempted route, which would surface as a stuck goal, visible in the report

advantages.statement: Fourteen intent records make the supplementary materials governable
advantages.amplified_value: Future agents can cite a lifecycle state instead of re-reading 60 KB of essays; prohibited and conflicted states prevent accidental authority

disadvantages.statement: More code on an unruled draft
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Additive modules plus one loop edit; the PR body gains a fourth-increment section; adoption remains NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION per the earlier deliberations

disadvantages.statement: status_now fields and the all-time treasury count mix clocks with windowed facts
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Resolved after the adversarial review: the hashed, recorded body is a pure function of records dated at or before the window end (goals folded as of until); registry state at report time is returned beside the report as an unhashed, unrecorded as_of_now envelope; the money basis names the executor's expected-vs-observed flag as the executor's report (test_a_closed_window_is_the_same_report_however_the_ledger_grows)

disadvantages.statement: The loop guard skips classification and could hide a legitimate re-evaluation
disadvantages.redesigned_response: The guard applies only when the route's latest record is an open or completed attempt; reconcile() releases failed routes; two regression tests pin both directions; an independent review attacks the path. The review found the one hidden dependency: the typed capability deficit was written only inside classify(), so a route already executed or open starved it; it is now recorded at the gate level, status() reads evidence state before the decision map, and the guard carries selected_by_deliberation (tests/unit/test_goal_gravity_guard.py)
Acceptable at current ledger sizes; named as an operator item with the existing rotation decision

disadvantages.statement: Verbatim preservation of AI-generated essays could be mistaken for founder doctrine
disadvantages.redesigned_response: The source file header labels each material's authorship; the intent records set prohibited/conflicted/exploratory states; the Master System Prompt is explicitly prohibited as protocol

pass_2.attack_summary: Assume pass 1 shipped. The report becomes the founder's habitual surface and its omissions become invisible; the schedule becomes a de facto scheduler contract; the guard becomes a place where a stuck route is never re-evaluated; the fourteen records become a second ledger format beside main's 15-field format; and the increment grows #160 past what one reviewer can hold.

new_weaknesses.statement: A founder who reads only the headline may miss that 'executed' means a Gate receipt on a synthetic executor
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The headline's last sentence states the evidence basis and that executor claims are not verification; the evidence_tier block names the limitation in full

new_weaknesses.statement: A host could treat suggested_trigger_id as authority to run
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The schedule returns no gate, grant or executor and its note says nothing here runs; turn() still requires a caller-supplied grant for any execution

new_weaknesses.statement: A route stuck in 'unknown' with no Gate observation and no accountable resolution is never re-evaluated
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: That is the intended fail-closed posture (SR001 P2); the report lists open attempts as of the window end and the blocker stays visible in status(); reconcile() with an accountable resolution is the release path

new_weaknesses.statement: Two intent-record formats coexist (skill schema vs the repository's 15-field ledger format)
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Already recorded as a format conflict by the third increment; this increment uses the schema the validators accept and notes the conflict for the ledger owner rather than restructuring main's record

new_weaknesses.statement: #160 grows to roughly 15k lines across four increments
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Each increment carries its own ADR, deliberation, evidence logs and PR section so a reviewer can rule increment by increment; nothing here changes the earlier increments' semantics beyond the guard

pass_2.final_design: AbsenceReporter and WakeSchedule as read-only folds attached to GoalGravityLoop (return_report, wake_schedule); prior-attempt guard before classification in turn(); closures extended; verbatim source files and the audit preserved; fourteen intent records; ADR-GOAL-GRAVITY-003; evidence logs; PR body section. Nothing activates, no grant is issued, no channel is contacted.
